name: gemfinder
title: gemfinder · narrative gems, crypto + stocks
description: Scans keyless public feeds (CoinGecko trending + category momentum, DexScreener boosts and new tokens, reddit mentions via ApeWisdom, Yahoo Finance trending and small-cap/day-gainer screens, Hacker News buzz) for crypto tokens and stocks a hot narrative is starting to carry. Merges per ticker, heats 13 narratives, and scores candidates by attention (attention, velocity, narrative, momentum, size) with reasons and risk flags. Type anything ("quantum", "frog", "nuclear drones") and it becomes a live theme matched by words AND by meaning: semantic search (MiniLM embeddings via the modsearch module, words-only fallback) gives every gem a fit 0-1, the nearest built-in narrative lends its seed stocks and categories, and CoinGecko/DexScreener/Yahoo search pull in more. Every gem gets an upside = score x fit x room-to-run (hard flags cut it); results sort by upside and the scan names one pick, the gem most likely to go up. /review prices past picks now vs then. Scans cached 10 min and warmed in the background. Stdlib-only, one SQLite cache. Attention, not a forecast.
state: ~/.mod/gemfinder/cache.db (raw HTTP bodies by url) · ~/.mod/gemfinder/scans.jsonl (every scan's picks + price) · in-process scan cache (SCAN_TTL 600s, GEMFINDER_SCAN_TTL to change; GEMFINDER_WARM=0 disables the warmer) · semantic: modsearch :51090 /embed (GEMFINDER_SEMANTIC=url|0, GEMFINDER_SEMANTIC_FLOOR 0.32), vectors cached in-process
